None yet. Pick a signature above and click a page to place it.

How signing works here. When you export, each signature is baked into the PDF with your name, the time, and a SHA-256 fingerprint of the document at signing. If the file is changed afterward, Makryden PDF flags it on open. That makes signatures valid under the U.S. ESIGN Act for most agreements — this is an electronic signature, not a PKI certificate-based digital signature.

Redaction

Pick the Redact tool in the toolbar and drag over anything sensitive — the area snaps to the text it covers. Then burn it in: the text is removed from the file itself, not just covered, and a black bar is fused over the spot.

No redaction areas staged.

On a scanned, image-only page there's no text layer to strip — the bar still covers the area, but treat scans with extra care.

Reduce file size

Recompresses the big photos inside the PDF at a leaner quality and strips the document's metadata (author, title, keywords). Text and pages stay exactly as they are.

Build a form

The Add field buttons in the toolbar drop brand-new fillable fields on any page — text, checkbox, dropdown, signature. Drag on the page to size the field (or just click for a standard size), name it, then fill it from the Fill form tab.
